items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week timeline (OUT already); Case Keenum expected to start MNF vs Eagles. Bagent cleared concussion but Keenum slated.
items.why: Grade 2 hamstring confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport; Keenum start
items.implication: CHI offense downgrade MNF and beyond; WRs/TEs/RBs volume/quality hit
items.opportunity: Limited for Bears skill; monitor Keenum efficiency

items.text: De'Von Achane (knee) ruled out vs Chiefs after early exit; Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said injury 'does not sound optimistic' with further testing upcoming. High-impact fantasy loss for remaining weeks if multi-game absence.
items.why: Knee injury in Q1, coach major concern per Rapoport/Schefter corroboration
items.implication: MIA RB committee opens; monitor handcuff/backup volume ROS
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for remaining Dolphins RBs if multi-week

items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury mid-game vs Bucs after limited production (2/32). Immediate target vacuum in Minnesota offense.
items.why: Ankle injury first half, ruled out
items.implication: Addison/Hockenson surge in targets short-term; ROS concern if multi-week
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Jordan Addison and T.J. Hockenson

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib/oblique strain vs Cardinals (after expected to play/hip Q). Full eval Monday; painful injury type.
items.why: Rib injury Q2, carted, ruled out; Rapoport confirms strain
items.implication: SF WR/TE target redistribution; Kittle/Samuel upside if multi-week
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Deebo Samuel, George Kittle, other SF WRs

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury late vs Lions after 13/32 rush + 3/23 rec. Ends his day and raises multi-game questions.
items.why: Thigh injury on tackle, ruled out
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead next week; monitor practice reports
items.opportunity: Snap/carry increase for Jets backup RBs

items.text: Zay Flowers active vs Cowboys after GTD/hamstring (team not counting on him; Levitan initially projected OUT). Berry: risky but start over Bateman if active for BAL.
items.why: Pregame workout looked good; Schefter confirmed active
items.implication: Full or limited snaps possible; Bateman/Andrews DFS pivot reverse
items.opportunity: Primary WR role if healthy enough; reverse prior Bateman upgrade
items.conflict: Levitan early OUT proj vs late ACTIVE

items.text: Levitan cash review: Garrett Wilson massive opp (Mitchell out + others missing, 30%+ targets dome vs Lions) at value; Jahmyr Gibbs must-play absurd role/price vs Jets; Kenneth Walker elite role vs weak MIA. Strong slate start.
items.why: Usage/role + matchup + price; Wilson vacuum confirmed post-Mitchell inactive
items.implication: Prioritize these in season-long/DFS residual; Wilson ROS boost if Mitchell lingers
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target shares realized or projected

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb on INT; coach Bowles says MRI Monday, likely to miss time. Jalen McMillan also out knee.
items.why: Dislocated thumb late game; coach confirms likely miss time
items.implication: TB backup QB next week(s); all Bucs pass-catchers downgrade short-term
items.opportunity: Monitor backup QB and any RB script change

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF vs Broncos (was doubtful/hip). Adams and other Rams WRs absorb targets.
items.implication: Davante Adams primary; short-term target boost
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for davante-adams and Rams pass-catchers

items.text: AD Mitchell (finger) expected inactive vs Lions (was GTD); Levitan: Jets WR depth chart Wilson #1, Isaiah Williams, etc. + TE Kenyon Sadiq hybrid slot/wide. Massive opportunity for Garrett Wilson (30%+ targets projected).
items.why: Mitchell inactive confirmed; prior high targets for Mitchell create vacuum
items.implication: Wilson clear alpha; high floor/ceiling in dome vs weak Lions secondary
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets/snaps for Wilson and secondary Jets WRs/TE

items.text: Brock Bowers active and making 2026 season debut for Raiders (was Q/knee, ETR expected to play). Immediate TE1 opportunity in LV offense.
items.why: Expected and confirmed active by Schefter/Raiders inactives
items.implication: High target share TE from snap 1; Mayer handcuff reverse

items.text: Commanders expected to sign FA RB Austin Ekeler (healed Achilles) to 53 pending physical; reunion after Panthers workout. Adds veteran depth behind current backs.
items.implication: WAS RB committee potential; handcuff or committee share if role expands
items.opportunity: Possible third-down/pass-game work; monitor depth chart

items.text: Raiders WR Jack Bech broken forearm, headed to IR (ruled out game); should return later season. Removes young depth piece.
items.implication: LV WR depth thinner behind primary options; Bowers even more central
items.opportunity: Slight target consolidation for remaining Raiders pass-catchers

items.text: Matthew Berry highlights Bhayshul Tuten fantasy support after Trevor Lawrence kneels to set up Tuten rushing TD. Positive usage/role signal for JAC RB.
items.why: Coach/QB intentional set-up for TD; volume opportunity
items.implication: Tuten gaining trust/carries in JAC backfield; waiver/ROS watch
